name: cheat curl
description: A heavier biceps curl that uses a small hip swing to get the bar past the sticking point. It lets you overload the biceps on the way up.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and swing your hips to start the lift.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower the bar slowly, resisting its weight.
Reset your posture before the next rep.
